purpose: Primary-source provenance for the Rev A.1 electrical design. Supplier mappings remain provisional until a new electrical freeze and board SHA are created.

footprint_and_polarity_review.method: Cross-check exact package/order code, physical pin numbering, diode/LED/MOSFET polarity, connector pin 1 and custom land patterns against the cited primary sources before electrical capture.
limitations: Generic resistor and small non-polar capacitor footprints are controlled by config/jlcpcb-parts.json.
Supplier stock remains volatile and is rechecked before ordering.

parts.evidence: WROOM-1 module with PCB antenna; supply range 3.0–3.6 V.
Revision B4 product drawing; J1 land pattern was verified against the recommended layout and is SHA-recorded in config/footprint-provenance.json.
DNL PCB contact footprint for the 10-pin Plug-of-Nails cable, with explicit keepout and no solder paste on contact pads.

Keyed 8-circuit 2.5 mm vertical XH header. The official drawing gives A=17.5 mm, B=22.4 mm and identifies circuit 1; KiCad Connector_JST:JST_XH_B8B-XH-A_1x08_P2.50mm_Vertical matches the 0.95 mm drill, 2.5 mm pitch and pin-1 orientation. Mating housing is XHP-8.
Seven-position 2.54 mm vertical through-hole development header with 0.635 mm square posts. The reviewed KiCad 1x7 vertical footprint uses 1.00 mm drills on 2.54 mm pitch; trusted internal use only.

Two-line, low-capacitance USB ESD protector in SOT-666. The verified pin map is 1/6 = I/O1, 3/4 = I/O2, 2 = GND and 5 = VBUS. ST specifies tightly matched D+/D- behavior, so either protection channel may carry either polarity; Rev A.1 assigns D+ to I/O1 and D- to I/O2 for crossover-free routing.
3.3 V fixed-output, 1.1 MHz, 2 A synchronous buck in TSOT26; BST-to-SW capacitor is 100 nF.

4.7 uH XGL4030 shielded inductor. Official data specifies 3.2 A at 20% inductance drop and 6.6 A for 40°C rise; the matching JLCPCB assembly listing is C7159276. Footprint authority is KiCad Inductor_SMD:L_Coilcraft_XxL4030.
16-pin TSSOP four-channel SPDT switch, bidirectional signal paths, and powered-off protection through 3.6 V.
Active-low open-drain supervisor in 3-pin SOT-23 with fixed delay option.
60 V N-channel SOT-23 MOSFET, style 21: pin 1 gate, pin 2 source, pin 3 drain.
30 V N-channel SOT-23 MOSFET.
30 V P-channel SOT-23 MOSFET; source/drain orientation is a release-critical check.
5 V reverse-standoff, 2 pF unidirectional ESD diode in SOD-323; pin 1 cathode and pin 2 anode. LCSC mapping is C139614.
22 uF, 25 V, X5R, 1206 MLCC. Official typical DC-bias curves show about -20.52% at 3.3 V and -37.96% at 5 V; curves are design-reference data, not guaranteed minima. LCSC mapping C12891.
5 V standoff unidirectional TVS in DO-214AA/SMB; assembly mapping C83333.
750 mA hold, 16 V resettable PTC in 1206; assembly mapping C371166.

Standard-production top-actuated 4.2 x 3.2 x 2.5 mm SMD tactile switch, 1.57 N and 1,000,000 cycles. Official circuit diagram binds pins 1/2 as one common and 3/4 as the other. Assembly mapping C470426 had more than 14,000 units at review on 2026-08-11.
Specified yellow-green 0603 power indicator; assembly mapping C125094.
Specified blue 0603 status indicator; assembly mapping C125096.

release_notes: Rev A.1 invalidates the previous board-SHA assembly mapping; config/jlcpcb-parts.json must be rebound after a new electrical and physical freeze.
J2 is a no-component Tag-Connect footprint; J3 and J4 are through-hole headers and are intentionally absent from the SMD assembly BOM/CPL.
PESD5V0U1UA,115 is mapped to LCSC C139614. J3/J4 are through-hole parts; recheck all stock before ordering and do not silently substitute them.
Always inspect JLCPCB's placement preview and polarity/orientation warnings before approving an order.
